import json

    [{\"a\": [1, 2]}, [[\"remove\", \"/a/0\"], [\"remove\", \"/missing\"]]],
    [{\"a/b\": {\"~x\": 1}}, [[\"replace\", \"/a~1b/~0x\", 2]]],

    [0, [[\"test\", \"\", 0]]],
    [[1, 2], [[\"replace\", \"/01\", 4]]],
    [[1, 2], [[\"add\", \"/2\", 3]]],
]
encoded = json.dumps(cases)
print(run(encoded))
assert json.loads(run(encoded)) == [
    {\"ok\": True, \"document\": {\"a\": [7, 9, 2]}},
    {\"ok\": False, \"document\": {\"a\": [1, 2]}},
    {\"ok\": True, \"document\": {\"a/b\": {\"~x\": 2}}},
    {\"ok\": True, \"document\": [1, 2, 3]},
    {\"ok\": True, \"document\": None},
    {\"ok\": True, \"document\": 0},
    {\"ok\": False, \"document\": [1, 2]},
    {\"ok\": True, \"document\": [1, 2, 3]},
]

assert present(Result([1])) == '[1]'
source = [[{\"x\": [1]}, [[\"add\", \"/x/0\", 8]]]]
before = json.loads(json.dumps(source))
solve(source)
assert source == before
